verdict.rationale: Lithic explicitly documents an agentic issuing use case by name: create a virtual card, assign it to an account, configure Authorization Rules to lock merchant category/MCC and set transaction/velocity limits, then test agent transactions against those rules (lithic-docs-11, lithic-docs-17, lithic-docs-13), and markets 'autonomous issuing, payments, and controls for AI-powered workflows' (lithic-docs-12). Card creation (lithic-docs-9) and rule engine at card/account/program level (lithic-docs-3) support the scoped-card mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation calling out per-card expiry as part of the agent-scoping use case, and independent/hands-on validation that an agent-issued card actually stays within policy in production.
